recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic photograph of a woman with long, dark, flowing hair, looking downwards. Her upper body is visible, with arms crossed. A large, stylized, translucent pink typographic element, 'A-POP', is overlaid across her torso, creating a dynamic visual effect.
coreVisualRelationships: The large, translucent pink text 'A-POP' is centrally overlaid on the woman's torso, creating a strong focal point.
The woman's dark, flowing hair contrasts with her lighter skin tone and the pale background, adding movement.
The monochromatic sepia-toned photograph of the woman serves as a muted backdrop for the vibrant pink typography.
The starburst graphic element within the 'A' of 'A-POP' adds an energetic accent to the typography.
coreInvariants: The woman's pose and expression, with hair flowing and arms crossed, should convey a sense of introspection or intensity.
The 'A-POP' typography must be large, bold, and rendered in a vibrant, translucent pink with a metallic or glossy sheen.
The typography must be overlaid on the woman's body, interacting with her form.
The overall color scheme should be predominantly monochromatic (sepia/grayscale) with a single, strong accent color for the text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The woman's upper body occupies the central and lower-right portion of the frame, scaled to fill approximately 70% of the vertical space. Her head is positioned in the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 'A-POP' text, due to its size, color, and central placement on the figure, acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The flowing hair creates a diagonal movement from top-left to mid-right. The eye then follows the 'A-POP' text across the woman's body, from left to right, and is drawn to the vibrant pink color.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper-left and upper-right corners, as well as a portion of the left side, feature a light, plain background, providing breathing room around the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The sepia-toned grayscale of the photograph provides the dominant, muted background color.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The dark tones of the woman's hair and clothing provide strong contrast against her skin and the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant, translucent hot pink serves as the sole accent color for the typography, drawing immediate attention.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background photograph has low saturation and moderate value, while the accent pink is highly saturated and has a bright, almost luminous value.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly monochromatic (sepia/grayscale) for the photographic elements.
One single, high-saturation accent color for the typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A sans-serif typeface with wide, open counters and moderately thick strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Letters are uppercase, blocky, and slightly condensed.
The 'A' has a sharp, pointed apex and a horizontal crossbar.
The 'P' has a large, open counter and a slightly extended bowl.
The overall form is geometric and robust.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' is integrated with a multi-pointed starburst graphic, replacing its crossbar and extending outwards.
The entire word 'A-POP' is skewed upwards from left to right, creating a dynamic, ascending angle.
The letters are rendered with a translucent, glossy, metallic pink effect, showing the underlying image through them.
The 'P' at the end is significantly larger and extends beyond the baseline of the other letters, with its bowl slightly distorted to follow the upward angle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic (sepia-toned or grayscale) photograph of a woman from the chest up, with long, dark, wavy hair flowing dynamically. She should be looking downwards with a contemplative or intense expression, arms crossed over her chest. The background should be plain and light, providing contrast. Ensure the lighting creates subtle highlights and shadows on her skin and hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: On top of the generated image, add the text 'A-POP' as a single, large, display element. The text should be rendered in a vibrant, translucent hot pink with a glossy or metallic sheen, allowing the underlying image to show through. The text should be angled upwards from left to right (approximately 10-15 degrees counter-clockwise rotation). Integrate a multi-pointed starburst graphic into the first 'A', replacing its crossbar and extending slightly beyond the letterform. The final 'P' should be noticeably larger than the other letters and slightly distorted to follow the upward angle. Position the text centrally across the woman's torso, interacting with her form.
